answer.title: Automated Invoice Generation on Job Completion
answer.trigger: A job is marked as complete in the jobs system by a team member.
steps: Detect when a job status changes to complete in the jobs system.
Extract job details and materials used from the completed job record.
Draft a new invoice in the accounts system using the extracted details.
Flag the draft invoice for human review before sending.
answer.ai_help: Extracting job line items and materials to pre-fill the correct invoice fields.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice in the accounts system before it is sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect billing amounts or invoicing the wrong customer could cause financial discrepancies and customer dissatisfaction.
